name: ローカルバイナリパターン分析
description: Computes LBP descriptors to capture micro-texture characteristics. AI生成の images produce 統計的ly distinct LBP 分布s.
mechanism: 比較します each pixel with 8 neighbors in circular パターン. Binary codes form ヒストグラムs capturing micro-texture. AI images show higher uniform ratios.
parameters: Radius: 1, Neighbors: 8, Pattern type: uniform, Bins: 256
useCase: Detecting synthetic micro-テクスチャパターン in AI images

references.title: Ojala, T. et al. (2002). Multi-resolution Gray-scale and Rotation Invariant Texture Classification. IEEE TPAMI.
Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
Ahonen, T. et al. (2006). Face Description with Local Binary Patterns. IEEE TPAMI.

strengths:
• 計算効率が高い texture descriptor
• Rotation-invariant with uniform パターン
• Captures micro-texture structures effectively
• Well-studied with extensive literature since 2002
• Robust to monotonic 照明 changes
limitations:
• Sensitive to image noise at pixel level
• Fixed radius limits multi-scale 分析
• Large neighborhoods increase computational cost
• JPEG圧縮 affects local パターン
• Modern AI can generate realistic micro-textures
